answer.rationale: With 14 days to expiry, no auto-renew, and the line at 94% with no buffer, a primary switch or deferral creates unacceptable continuity risk, while renewing the incumbent as-is conflicts with the mandated 18% cut after refusal to reopen price. I am verifying the two memories most material to the cost/risk tradeoff: fast low-cost vendor onboarding and second-source resilience. Intended path is a guarded second-source qualification that keeps incumbent supply stable, removes single-point failure, and creates pricing leverage for the next review; it may not deliver the full 18% in-cycle, so downstream value risk is flagged.
